fields.summary: Dept/job role packaging: Retail CSR Required Roles + SoD-safe IT packs
fields.description: For Retail CSR / branch job roles (MNB-Role-* / MNB-IT-* per lessons 25–26): inventory Required Roles, ensure WireInit and WireAppr are never co-required, and CloudAdmin is not birthright. Use list_agent_roles, set_role_requirements if remediation needed. Document composition table in evidence. Do not call update_rule_source or grant_capability.
